input = add-recipe n/Rice cal/200 p/4 c/45 f/1 i/Rice:150g
[first five fields: n, cal, p, c, f]
Validate syntax and positive decimal quantity.
Append ingredient to the local list.
[nutrition fields: cal, p, c, f, in this order]
Solid filled-arrow messages are synchronous calls; dashed messages are returns.
Creation messages begin new lifelines. Constructor returns are consistently omitted.
Underlined MishMash denotes the class containing the static application methods.
Model constructor internals, standard-library operations, and logging are condensed.
RecipeBook is not accessed during parsing.
